principle: IRFEN se expande por riesgo, recurrencia, exposición, aislamiento y brecha de respuesta; nunca por tamaño o notoriedad de la ciudad únicamente.

allowed_before_v08_closure: document historical activations and exposed settlements
test source availability without publishing alerts
not_allowed_before_v08_closure: copy a pilot rule to another catchment
prioritize a location only because it has a large population

equity_rules: Small or rural settlements are not penalized for having fewer inhabitants.
Data scarcity is recorded as a deployment constraint, not interpreted as low risk.
Each expansion wave must include northern, central and southern coastal territories.
At least half of the first expansion shortlist must be outside Metropolitan Lima.
minimum_evidence: official ANA, CENEPRED, INGEMMET or INDECI critical point or event record
identifiable catchment, ravine, river reach or fan/outlet geometry
documented exposed settlement, road, service, agriculture or evacuation constraint
meteorological observation or defensible remote-sensing path
mechanism classification before choosing a model

candidate_corridors_for_official_invento.instruction: Model as a compound corridor: separate short-response ravines, Santa Eulalia river contribution and Rímac receiving-channel level/capacity. Simultaneous activation is a scenario to validate, never a reason to infer overflow from rainfall alone.

candidate_corridors_for_official_invento.corridor: Lima norte y cuencas costeras del norte de Lima
candidate_corridors_for_official_invento.instruction: Identify individual ravines and settlements from official point inventories; do not use a metropolitan proxy.
Separate local debris-flow ravines from river and coastal flood mechanisms.

candidate_corridors_for_official_invento.corridor: Ica, Chincha, Pisco, Palpa y Nazca
candidate_corridors_for_official_invento.instruction: Use ANA 2021/2025 critical-point records and INGEMMET/CENEPRED studies to resolve individual ravines and exposed settlements.
Represent both debris-flow ravines and river-valley flooding; preserve small agricultural settlements in the ranking.

examples_to_verify: La Libertad fuera de San Ildefonso
candidate_corridors_for_official_invento.instruction: Prioritize documented recurrent activation and exposed communities rather than departmental capitals.
Inventory short-response ravines, road isolation and settlements on alluvial fans before selecting pilots.

first_wave_design.geographic_balance: north, central and south coast represented
first_wave_design.urban_rural_balance: minimum 50% outside Metropolitan Lima; include small or rural exposed settlements
first_wave_design.selection_output: ranked shortlist with evidence, mechanism, geometry, data sources, exposed population/services, lead time and unresolved gates
first_wave_design.activation_rule: No candidate becomes operational until it passes a zone-specific validation contract.

analog_transfer_reference.allowed_use: RESEARCH_ONLY scenario and sensitivity runs when local historical events are insufficient
